method_expansion: Spectral Information and Trust-Region reconstruction of wall-normal heat flux

scientific_role.observed_failure: MV14 reduced the exact weak energy-balance residual but did not improve legacy q_y over MV9 vision-only or paired Raw_B10
working_hypotheses: corner extrapolation can induce systematic amplitude shrinkage and mean offset
Raw_B1 can measure selected low-frequency modes more reliably than a learned conditional mean
the one-block information limit remains an open alternative until a spectral bound and controlled estimator are evaluated
scientific_role.purpose: separate spectral information, extrapolation bias, and observation contribution before authorizing any new DSMC trajectory

information_audit_contract.transform: orthonormal two-dimensional DCT-II with nonperiodic cavity boundaries
information_audit_contract.replicate_rule: cross-spectra and half-difference noise spectra use matching block indices from distinct development seeds only
information_audit_contract.signal_power_estimator: positive part of the mean cross-spectrum between independent-seed B1 replicates
information_audit_contract.noise_power_estimator: one half the mean squared DCT difference between independent-seed B1 replicates
information_audit_contract.linear_MMSE_bound: sum_k S_k N_k/(S_k+N_k), reported against the ideal independent Raw_B10 noise N_k/10

spectral_fusion_contract.development_optimal_weight: per radial bin, clipped minimum-MSE convex weight using development residual variances and covariance
spectral_fusion_contract.selection: leave one entire development condition out; minimize the equally weighted mean held-condition q_y NRMSE
spectral_fusion_contract.final_refit: refit weights on all development conditions using the selected shrinkage and smoothing

control_contract.condition_only_model: ridge regression of the development condition-mean field on [1, log10(Kn), U/100, log10(Kn)*U/100] with ridge 0.01; it never sees indexed B1
control_contract.permutation_control: cyclically exchange Raw_B1 q_y between distinct legacy conditions while retaining the locked vision prediction and condition identity
control_contract.claim_rule: an observation-driven reconstruction claim requires fusion to beat condition-only, vision-only, TSVD, and its cross-condition permutation control

exact_diagnostic_contract.normalization: all terms use the same pooled target RMS used by q_y NRMSE

analysis_contract.authorization_rule: all gates must pass before separately locking new DSMC seeds; legacy success alone is never confirmation
analysis_contract.failure_rule: return the information audit and exact error budget without tuning on legacy labels
